samples.summary: PPTX export only guards the `''` case, so the same invalid-OOXML class the delta fixes for DOCX remains for slides

verdict.reason: The claimed code exists as described. `hasColor` (packages/slides/src/export/pptx/text.ts:180-182) only rejects null/undefined and the exact `''` string — it lets any other string through and never inspects the `{kind:'srgb', value}` object arm. `colorChildXml` (packages/slides/src/export/pptx/color.ts:35-36) then emits `<a:srgbClr val="...">` after only stripping a leading `#`, uppercasing and XML-escaping, with no ST_HexColorRGB validation, so `'rgb(0, 128, 255)'` becomes `val="RGB(0, 128, 255)"` and `{kind:'srgb', value:''}` becomes `val=""` — precisely the invalid output the new comment at text.ts:174-178 says PowerPoint rejects. The DOCX side of the same delta does validate: `toDocxHexColor` (packages/docs/src/export/docx-style-map.ts:34-75) normalizes hex/#RGB/#RRGGBBAA/rgb()/rgba() and drops anything else, applied to run props and table cell fill (docx-style-map.ts:121,125; docx-exporter.ts:319), and the task doc itself scopes PPTX to only the `''` convention (docs/tasks/active/20260812-docs-font-color-reset-todo.md:47-60), confirming the half-applied fix. Reachability holds: HTML paste copies browser CSS colors verbatim (packages/docs/src/view/clipboard.ts:150-151) through the docs paste path (packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:1117), and slides text boxes run on the docs editor (packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:24-34 -> packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:417); the empty-value srgb object shape is documented as reachable at packages/docs/src/model/color.ts:39-43. No upstream guard normalizes StoredColor before the PPTX sink, so I cannot refute on not-present, already-guarded, or out-of-scope grounds — the incomplete application of the delta's own stated hardening across the parallel export sink is a fit/spec-conformance gap.

finding.summary: PPTX export does not adopt the PR's "'' means unset" convention, so legacy cleared colors serialize as `<a:srgbClr val=""/>`
finding.evidence: The plan (docs/tasks/active/20260812-docs-font-color-reset-todo.md, Non-goals) explicitly declines a migration: documents keep `color: ""` forever and every consumer is expected to treat it as unset. This delta pushed that convention through the canvas painters (paint-layout, table-renderer, resolveColorAtPosition) and through DOCX (where `defaultColorResolver('')` is falsy so the element is skipped), but the PPTX run/marker serializers guard with `!= null` only: `if (s.color != null) children.push('<a:solidFill>' + colorChildXml(storedColorToThemeColor(s.color)) + '</a:solidFill>')` (text.ts:263-266), and likewise `marker.color != null` (line 134), `s.backgroundColor != null` (270), `s.underlineColor != null` (277). A stored `''` therefore reaches `colorChildXml`, which emits `<a:srgbClr val=""/>` — an invalid OOXML color attribute — for exactly the decks this PR says will keep carrying `''`. Since slides reuses the docs rich-text model, this is the same issue-#728 surface the delta chose to fix everywhere else and is the one paint/serialize path left inconsistent.

verdict.reason: The claimed code is not present. The PPTX text serializer does not guard colors with `!= null`; it uses a dedicated `hasColor()` predicate that returns `c != null && c !== ''` (text.ts:180-182), documented as implementing the issue-#728 "'' means unset" convention precisely because `<a:srgbClr val=""/>` is invalid ST_HexColorRGB. All four sites the finding names use it: bullet marker color (text.ts:134), run solidFill (277), highlight (284), underline uFill (291). A grep for `color.*!= null` across packages/slides/src/export/pptx yields no matches. The plan's own checklist marks this item done and names `hasColor` in `export/pptx/text.ts` as the fix (todo.md:56-60), and the promised slides test exists, asserting `color: ''`/`backgroundColor: ''`/`underlineColor: ''` emit no color children (test/export/pptx/text.test.ts:88-102). So `''` never reaches `colorChildXml`, and the quoted evidence lines do not exist in the file.
